description: AMENDMENT-19, ADR-020 D1: synthetic, hand-written. The adapter reports acceptEdits and refuses session/set_mode default: the session cannot be pinned, so the launch fails closed as could-not-start (cause 3: the adapter was found and ran, but it would not start in the mode DwarfAI requires) and no prompt is sent. The launch binds no session, so the set_mode frame names the agent's session id literally.

rejected.detail: the agent kept permission mode acceptEdits: set_mode default was refused with -32603
